ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; dominant low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface with minimal high-intensity (white) localized to distal tip barnacles.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (jagged profile) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep with a shallow convex curve along the superior margin extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple faint, low-contrast circular ring-like pixel patterns distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textured, high-contrast colonization (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
